name: Equipped armor repair returns to its original slot

steps._note: Run in solo and dedicated Purge. Prepare a damaged equipped armor piece and one stack of compatible repair materials, then select the equipped piece in Character. Capture equipment and inventory before activating Repair.

Verify the original slot holds the repaired piece, wear decreased, and no copy appeared in inventory. Repeat with a different piece equipped in that slot before completion, then with armor repaired directly from the backpack. Verify the replacement stays equipped and each repaired item is delivered once.
